description: This file contains client-side JavaScript functions for UI interactions, including toggling user preferences display, selecting an organization, and adding CSS classes to form elements on DOM content loaded.

methods.name: showHideUserPref
methods.description: Toggles the display style of the element with id 'user-details' between 'none' and 'flex'.

methods.name: selectOrgaOK
methods.description: Triggers a click on the organization element and hides the modal with id 'selectOrga'.
